title: 《雅琴看世界》英文專訪沈伯洋：洋流、城市交流與傾聽的力量

* **\[00:08:50\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：But also you said that also that will be okay for Shanghai or Beijing or Chongqing — they're all okay, and you know, if they don't have any political precondition, that would be okay, right?  
  * （但你也說過，無論是上海、北京或重慶其實都可以——只要他們不設任何政治前提，就都可以交流，對吧？）
text:
* **\[00:09:01\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Yeah, and that's acceptable to me, and you have to have like equal standards, right? Right, but we still need to do some like risk management.  
  * （對，那對我來說是可以接受的，而且雙方必須基於對等的標準，對吧？不過，我們還是必須做好「風險管理（risk management）」。）  
* **\[00:09:08\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Uh-huh, what kind of risk management?  
  * （嗯哼，什麼樣的風險管理？）  
* **\[00:09:10\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Like the sovereignty — sovereignty is the most important stuff. And then cybersecurity — cybersecurity, you have to protect your own data. So there should be, I mean, some protection on our side. But when we're doing this kind of risk management, it doesn't mean that we didn't want to negotiate, didn't want to communicate. We just need to, I mean, communicate with our eyes open\! And that's the spirit: we need to be transparent, we need to show that, "Hey, this is beneficial to Taipei, that's why we want to communicate with you."  
  * （例如「主權（sovereignty）」——主權是最重要的事；再來是「資安（cybersecurity）」——你必須保護好自己的市政與市民資料。所以我們這一端必須具備防護機制。但當我們在落實這些風險管理時，並不代表我們不願談判、不願溝通；我們只是必須「睜大眼睛（with our eyes open）」進行溝通！這就是核心精神：我們必須公開透明（transparent），必須向市民清楚證明：「嘿，這項交流對台北市確實有益，所以我們才與對方溝通。」）  
* **\[00:09:38\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：That's right. Also, I have a follow-up for this, you know — um, if Chinese military aircraft continue to fly around Taiwan, would you still hold the Taipei-Shanghai city forum? Because we know that Taipei City Council passed a resolution that if the China aircraft fly around Taiwan, then we will no longer have this meeting, but you know Chiang Wan-an still did that. What about you?  
  * （沒錯。此外我還有一個追問：如果中國軍機持續繞台飛行，你還會舉辦台北上海雙城論壇嗎？因為我們知道台北市議會曾通過一項決議，若共機持續擾台就不應再舉辦雙城論壇，但蔣萬安還是照辦了。那你呢？）  
* **\[00:10:02\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：I think it happened last time, right?  
  * （我記得上次就發生過這種事，對吧？）  
* **\[00:10:04\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Yeah, it happened\!  
  * （對，就發生過！）  
* **\[00:10:05\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Yeah, he flew back from Shanghai and then we got the drills — and we got the, I think it's 2025\. For me, it's **not acceptable**, okay? Because we're Taiwanese people, right? And we stand for our city, but also we stand up as Taiwanese, so we need to protect our territory, we need to protect our country. Maybe this forum could be a way that how we negotiate with others, but when you enter this forum, when you try to deliver your idea and you send a message to them, and then still have this kind of drilling — for this kind of drill, for me is not acceptable.  
  * （對，2025 年他才剛從上海飛回來，我們馬上就面對中共的軍演。對我來說，這是**完全無法接受的（not acceptable）**！因為我們是台灣人，對吧？我們代表我們的城市，但我們也身為台灣人挺身而出，必須保衛我們的領土、保護我們的國家。或許這個論壇可以作為雙方溝通協商的一種管道，但當你走進這個論壇、試圖傳達理念並釋出訊息後，對方卻依然對台灣發動這種軍事演習——這種軍演對我而言是絕對無法接受的。）  
* **\[00:10:40\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Mhm, okay.  
  * （嗯哼，了解。）

# **第 05 章｜第四題：民調如「溫度計」哲學、「市長，你給我聽好了」6 萬則市民留言與街頭肥皂箱解方（00:10:41 \- 00:14:09）**

* **\[00:10:41\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：My last question will be that according to the latest poll, you're leading the incumbent Mayor Chiang with 17% of the vote. Are you confident that you will win the election?  
  * （我的最後一個問題是，根據最新公布的一份民調，你領先現任市長蔣萬安達 17 個百分點。你有信心贏得這場選舉嗎？）  
* **\[00:10:53\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Well, that would be — that's a tough question\! That's a tough question, because there are a lot of polls recently...  
  * （哇，這是一道難題！這問題不容易回答，因為最近有非常多份民調……）  
* **\[00:10:59\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Well, actually we have two polls already: one you kind of lead 17%, the other is also leading like 3.8%, something like that, yeah\!  
  * （其實已經有兩份民調顯示你領先：一份你領先約 17%，另一份也領先約 3.8% 左右！）  
* **\[00:11:08\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Yeah, because at the very beginning, I think there's a poll, I mean, showing that I was behind by 28%\!  
  * （對，因為在最開始的時候，我記得有一份民調顯示我落後高達 28%！）  
* **\[00:11:14\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Yeah, that was\! And then we got — okay, what happened? What happened? What exactly happened? I mean, also I think Chiang Wan-an also was wondering what happened\!  
  * （對，當時確實是那樣！結果現在——到底發生了什麼事？究竟發生了什麼變化？我想連蔣萬安應該也在納悶到底發生什麼事了！）  
* **\[00:11:26\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：Yeah, it would be a long explanation on that\!  
  * （哈哈，那說來話長了！）  
* **\[00:11:28\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：Yeah, so yeah, we will do that in the Chinese version later, but we have to — yeah, let's talk about it\! I mean, are you confident that you will win the election?  
  * （好，這部分我們等一下在中文版專訪再深入聊，但我們還是先談談——你有信心贏得這場選戰嗎？）  
* **\[00:11:35\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：So first, I mean, back to the poll — and there are lots of polls. I mean, some say that I'm right now still down by 8%, and there's another one showing that — I think yesterday or two days ago — saying that I'm, I mean, won by 3%. So there are like so many polls, so if I check every poll, I got a whiplash, I guess\!  
  * （首先回到民調來看，現在有非常多不同的民調——有些民調說我目前還落後 8%，也有昨天或前天出來的民調說我領先 3%。民調實在太多了，如果我每份民調都要跟著起伏，我的脖子大概都要扭傷了（whiplash）！）  
* **\[00:11:51\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：So, but however, that's what I always said: the poll is just on the paper. **The poll is like a thermometer** — the poll actually shows you the temperature today, but they didn't really tell you the result, I mean, on November 28th. So the victory is still on the ballot, so that's why we're still waiting for that.  
  * （不過這也是我一直強調的：民調只是紙上的數字。**民調就像是一支溫度計（thermometer）**——它只告訴你今天的溫度是多少，但並不能真正告訴你最後投票日的結果。真正的勝利仍在選票（ballot）上，所以我們依然持續努力。）  
* **\[00:12:11\] 沈伯洋（Puma Shen）**：But back to the confidence question — I mean, from day one when I entered this election, **I came to win**, right?  
  * （但回到有沒有信心的問題——從我投入這場選舉的第一天起，**我就是來贏的（I came to win）**，對吧？）  
* **\[00:12:18\] 主持人 張雅琴（Catherine Chang）**：You came to win\!  
  * （你就是來贏的！）
